title: Long non-coding RNAs and enhancer RNAs regulate the lipopolysaccharide-induced inflammatory response in human monocytes
description: Investigating the response of long non-coding RNA expression to LPS stimulation in human monocytes.  This experiment is related to the microarray study E-MTAB-2408.

samples.title: primary_monocyte_6
samples.description: Protocols: Monocytes were separated with the Miltenyi Monocyte Isolation kit II (Miltenyi biotec) and re-suspended in RPMI 1640 medium (supp. 2 mM L-glutamine 10,000 U/mL penicillin 10 mg/mL streptomycin and 10% (v/v) fetal bovine serum (Invitrogen, Paisley, UK)) Experimental samples were treated with 10ng/ml LPS for 4 hours and the controls were left untreated (n = 4 per group). Total RNA was extracted using the Qiagen RNeasy kit and included an on-column DNase treatment Ribosomal RNA (rRNA) was depleted using an early-access version of the Ribo-Zero Gold rRNA Removal Kit (Epicentre). Strand-specific cDNA libraries were prepared using an early-access version of the ScriptSeq v2 library preparation kit (Epicentre)

runs.experiment_title: Illumina Genome Analyzer IIx paired end sequencing: Long non-coding RNAs and enhancer RNAs regulate the lipopolysaccharide-induced inflammatory response in human monocytes
